D.t: Maxine Dexter leads by 56.2 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 191,136 votes; a one point swing is about 1,701 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +50.0 and D +61.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
